tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Leʾah; the etymology is uncertain, often given as 'weary' or 'delicate'. Its root is Hebrew l-ʾ-h. Leah, wife of Jacob (Genesis 29). Leah is a Hebrew name meaning “Weary; delicate”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
